mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_id, user_id, product_id, activity_id, source, price, status, paid_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{activityId}, #{source}, #{price}, #{status}, #{paidAt})

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_order (order_id, user_id, product_id, activity_id, source, price, status, paid_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{activityId}, #{source}, #{price}, #{status}, #{paidAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status = 2

SELECT id, order_id, user_id, product_id, activity_id, source, price, status, created_at, paid_at, updated_at FROM t_order WHERE status = 1 AND created_at < #{timeoutBefore} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = 3, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_id, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.activity_id, o.source, o.price, o.status, o.created_at, o.paid_at, o.updated_at FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_point_log l ON l.biz_type = 2 AND l.biz_ref = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 2 AND l.id IS NULL ORDER BY o.created_at ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.product_id AS productId, p.title AS productTitle, p.cover_url AS coverUrl, o.price AS price, CASE o.status WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PAID' WHEN 3 THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS status, o.source AS source, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.paid_at AS paidAt FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_id = #{orderId}
